title: Action de Galois sur Teichmüller : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context (pp. 15-17): Grothendieck is describing the endomorphisms u of a profinite fundamental groupoid. The groupoid is the 'universal' groupoid of the first level of the Teichmüller tower, with S_3 acting on it. Its base points are tangential/standard points of P^1 minus {0,1,∞} (equivalently M_{0,4}). The endomorphisms fix the vertices and commute with S_3.

Previous page:
- (54) Such a u is determined by the images of the generating paths a_i^ω, b_i^ω, d_i^ω. Each image is the generating path twisted by an element λ, η, ζ of \hat Π_{0,3}, the free profinite group on two generators, transported by the identifications φ_i^ω, ψ_i^ω.
- Rather than computing relations (48) directly, he applies a van Kampen-type gluing. The universal groupoid is covered by subgroupoids II and IV with intersection III. So u amounts to an endomorphism (λ,η) of II and an endomorphism ζ of IV inducing the same endomorphism α̃ of III.
- (55) records this as α̃ = η^{-1}ε_0(λη) and α̃ = ζρ^{-1}(ζ)^{-1}. Here ρ is the order-3 rotation of {0,1,∞}, and σ_∞, ε_0 are the involution-type automorphisms coming from S_3.

This page:
- (i) The compatibility condition attached to (λ,η) alone is a 3-cycle condition of the form α̃ ρ^{-1}(α̃) ρ^{-2}(α̃) = 1, with α̃ given by the first formula in (55).
- (ii) He observes that this condition follows automatically from the second formula in (55). Indeed, if α̃ = ζρ^{-1}(ζ)^{-1}, the product telescopes to ζρ^{-3}(ζ)^{-1} = 1 because ρ^3 = 1.
- (iii) So the only relation among (λ,η,ζ) is (56): η^{-1}ε_0(λη) = ζρ^{-1}(ζ)^{-1}, with α̃ eliminated.
- (iv) He changes variables to quantities 'more familiar to me' that describe the action on other paths (57):
  - β = σ_∞(η)η^{-1}, governing u(b_i^ω);
  - α = σ_∞(λ)β, governing u(b̃_i^ω);
  - α̃, governing u(ã_i^ω).
- (v) He inverts them (58)/(59): β' = β^{-1} = ησ_∞(η)^{-1} (= σ_∞(β), since σ_∞ is an involution) and α' = α^{-1} = β'σ_∞(λ^{-1}), i.e. β' = α'σ_∞(λ).

Next page:
- Writing ζ' = ηζ, (56) becomes α' = ζ'ρ(ζ')^{-1}, i.e. ησ_∞(η)^{-1} = ζ'ρ(ζ')^{-1}σ_∞(λ).
- The S_3-compatible vertex-fixing endomorphisms then correspond to triples (λ,η,ζ') in \hat Π_{0,3}^3 satisfying one relation. Grothendieck asks whether this is 'la relation des tresses'.

Purpose: this is the computation of the 'first level' (M_{0,4} with S_3 symmetry) of the Teichmüller-tower description of Gal(Q̄/Q) acting on \hat π_1. It is the precursor of the 2-cycle/3-cycle (hexagon-type) relations defining Drinfeld's \hat{GT}. The page itself is the algebraic reduction step: van Kampen gluing, eliminating the cocycle condition, and a change of variables.
errors: No mathematical error detected. The inversions in (58)/(59) are correct: β^{-1} = ησ_∞(η)^{-1}; α^{-1} = β^{-1}σ_∞(λ)^{-1} = β'σ_∞(λ^{-1}), hence β' = α'σ_∞(λ).
The marginal annotation over β' should read σ_∞(β) (σ_∞ an involution gives σ_∞(β) = β^{-1}). If it really reads σ_0(β), that is a slip.
Claim (ii), that the 3-cycle condition follows from the second formula in (55), is correct but silently uses ρ^3 = id on \hat Π_{0,3}.
The page is heavily struck through around (59): the definition of the modified ζ' is deferred to p.17. As written here, the variable change is incomplete.

ideas.what: Describing S_3-equivariant, vertex-fixing endomorphisms of the profinite fundamental groupoid of P^1-{0,1,∞}/M_{0,4} (several base points) by twisting parameters in \hat Π_{0,3}, subject to relations
ideas.modern_name: Groupoid (tangential base point) description of \hat{GT}-type actions; Harbater–Schneps / Lochak–Schneps groupoid formalism
ideas.usually_credited_to: Drinfeld (1990) for \hat{GT}; Ihara (1990-91); Harbater–Schneps (2000) for the groupoid version
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (1984), §2-3, programmatic only, without these explicit equations

ideas.what: Using a van Kampen covering of the groupoid by subgroupoids II and IV glued along III, reducing an endomorphism to compatible pieces
ideas.modern_name: Seifert–van Kampen for groupoids (pushout of groupoids)
ideas.usually_credited_to: R. Brown (1967); Grothendieck in SGA1 for the profinite étale version
ideas.where_published: SGA1 Exp. IX (van Kampen for étale π_1); groupoid viewpoint in Esquisse

ideas.what: Elimination of the order-3 cocycle condition α̃ρ^{-1}(α̃)ρ^{-2}(α̃) = 1 because α̃ is a ρ-coboundary ζρ^{-1}(ζ)^{-1}
ideas.modern_name: 3-cycle relation of GT (f(x,y)f(y,z)f(z,x) type) / coboundary for Z/3 action

ideas.what: Final reduction to triples (λ,η,ζ') in \hat Π_{0,3}^3 with a single relation, asked to be 'la relation des tresses'

missed.claim: Grothendieck parametrizes S_3-equivariant vertex-fixing endomorphisms (not only automorphisms) of the M_{0,4} groupoid by non-abelian data in \hat Π_{0,3}. He reduces the conditions to a single relation and only conjectures ('relation des tresses ?') its identification with the braid/hexagon relation. This is a pre-Drinfeld explicit derivation of GT-type equations from the groupoid with S_3 symmetry. Its exact relation to \hat{GT} (in particular the endomorphism-monoid version) is not settled on these pages.
missed.quote: Il reste donc, comme relations reliant λ,η,ζ, que la relation (55) sous la forme (où ne figure plus α̃) (56) η^{-1}ε_0(λη)=ζρ^{-1}(ζ)^{-1}
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Comparing this parametrization with the Drinfeld/Ihara and Harbater–Schneps descriptions would document Grothendieck's independent route to the GT relations (c. 1980-81). It might also yield a monoid analogue (\hat{GT} endomorphisms) via a van Kampen gluing argument rather than the pentagon/hexagon formalism. This is of historical interest; it is probably not new mathematically to specialists.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a routine algebraic reduction: van Kampen gluing, a telescoping coboundary, and inversion of variables. In context it is part of an explicit, unpublished pre-Drinfeld computation of GT-type defining relations for the M_{0,4} groupoid with S_3 symmetry. The existence of such work is known from the Esquisse, but the explicit equations are not in print.
transcription_corrections: Line 2: 'ξ α̃ρ^{-1}(α̃)ρ^{-1}(α̃)' should read α̃ρ^{-1}(α̃)ρ^{-2}(α̃) (presumably = 1); the second exponent is -2.
The letter transcribed 'ξ' throughout is the same variable as 'ζ' on p.15 (the parameter of the d_i^ω).
Annotation above β' should probably be '=σ_∞(β)', not '=σ_0(β)'.
'et on les modifiant ainsi' should read 'et en les modifiant ainsi'.
'Les nouvelles [?] ... Γ dites' is a struck/garbled passage; the surviving sense is roughly 'les données (λ,η,ζ) ∈ \hat Π_{0,3} (équivalent à la donnée ...) en lesquelles j'exprime α', β' par (59)'.
